summary: W6 structural closure and explainable results handoff. Coding/Repair must preserve W4 seed retrieval and W5 purpose-policy selection while adding coherent-result canonical-version evidence, same-version relationship endpoint closure, complete non-cascading View closure, and single first-inclusion provenance with policy/index/version evidence.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Submit legacy and semantic-query tasks against the same canonical graph version.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Legacy reading remains complete and semantic canonicalVersion equals the governing legacy graph version; missing version evidence fails DT00_CANONICAL_VERSION_MISSING and mismatched evidence fails DT00_CANONICAL_VERSION_MISMATCH.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run a purpose-closed relationship range with endpoint closure fixtures requiring at least one returned relationship plus dangling and cross-version endpoint cases.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: At least one relationship object exposes source/target ids, matching source/target Element object identities, same-version evidence tied to the governing result version, and dangling/cross-version structural errors.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run a matched View query naming target View grag-integrity-explainability and overlapping Views grag-quality-capacity and grag-vertical-chain-b, requiring in-View relationships plus a parent viewpoint.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The target View is present; overlapping Views are absent unless independently matched or explicitly requested; selected Views include complete metadata, viewpoint binding, parent viewpoint, exact included element ids matching member objects, exact relationship ids matching relationship objects, and complete relationship endpoints.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run explicit duplicate-path fixtures across semantic seed, relationship endpoint closure, purpose-policy closure, and complete-View closure.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Every returned object has exactly one ordered firstInclusionReason, expected supplementary reasons never overwrite it, and policy id, policy parameters/anchors, canonical/content/index versions, and alignment state are complete.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: ArchitectureBoundaryGuard
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Inspect root, query-service, and Graph RAG contracts for W6 coherent-result boundary declarations.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Contracts declare W6 canonical-version, endpoint, View, and provenance result-completion semantics.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: DependencyDirectionGuard
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Inspect production runtime modules for outward dependencies on tests.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Production code does not import tests or frozen entrypoint assets.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: ExplicitEntrypointCorrectnessGuard
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Inspect frozen W6 entrypoints and Harness-owned assertions.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: Entrypoints keep GIVEN/WHEN/THEN readability, use the Harness abstraction, and include W6 failure categories.

criticalNonExplicitTests.name: KeyImplementationTraceabilityGuard
criticalNonExplicitTests.controlPoint: Inspect intent anchors, root contract mappings, and mounted testcase paths.
criticalNonExplicitTests.observationPoint: W6 implementation mappings reference grag-coherent-context, grag-endpoint-closure, grag-view-closure, and grag-provenance, and all mounted W6 entrypoints exist.

codingTargets.nextAction: Surface governing canonicalVersion evidence on semantic-query responses and ensure it equals the canonical version or Harness-defined fingerprint of the legacy graph used for the same read.

Extend purpose-closed results with non-empty endpointClosure relationships, source/target ids, matching endpoint objects, same-version evidence tied to the governing result version, and dangling/cross-version structural error evidence.

codingTargets.failureSignal: DT14_VIEW_CLOSURE_MISSING / DT14_TARGET_VIEW_NOT_RETURNED / DT14_OVERLAPPING_VIEW_RETURNED / DT14_MEMBER_OBJECT_SET_INCOMPLETE / DT14_RELATIONSHIP_OBJECT_SET_INCOMPLETE / DT14_PARENT_VIEWPOINT_MISSING
codingTargets.nextAction: Add complete selected-View closure that returns the target View by id, excludes named overlapping Views unless independently matched or explicitly requested, and includes metadata, parent viewpoint, exact member and relationship object sets, and endpoint-complete in-View relationships.

Add provenance objects satisfying the explicit duplicate-path fixture order, with one firstInclusionReason, non-overwriting supplementary reasons, policy id, policy parameters/anchors, canonical/content/index versions, and alignment evidence.

taskExecutionPlan.executionStrategy: Implement W6 as structural result completion after W5 purpose-policy range selection. Preserve W4 seed retrieval, W5 policy selection, graph-tidy full-snapshot bypass, W7 quality scoring, and runner-owned deliveryStatus semantics. Frozen files are read-only during Coding/Repair.

tasks.title: Expose coherent-result canonical version
tasks.objective: Make semantic-query results traceable to the same canonical graph version as the legacy full read.
steps: Derive canonicalVersion from the canonical graph snapshot used by the query service, matching graph.version when present or the Harness-defined canonical fingerprint otherwise.
Preserve the no-argument legacy envelope and add equal version evidence only to semantic-query response metadata/result evidence.
tasks.completionSignal: runCoherentIntentReading.js exits 0 and no-argument compatibility tests remain green.

tasks.title: Complete relationship endpoints
tasks.objective: Return each relationship with same-version source and target Elements or explicit structural errors.
steps: Build a non-empty endpointClosure from the W5 selected relationship range using canonical relationship source_id and target_id.
Attach source and target Element objects whose ids match those endpoint ids and whose canonicalVersion matches the governing result version.
Report missing, deleted, invalid, or cross-version endpoint references through structuralErrors rather than partial relationship output.
tasks.completionSignal: runRelationshipEndpointClosure.js exits 0 with same-version endpoint objects and structural error evidence.

tasks.title: Complete selected Views
tasks.objective: Complete matched View objects without cascading into overlapping Views by shared membership.
steps: Build viewClosure only for the target View grag-integrity-explainability and any Views independently matched or explicitly requested by the W5/W6 query.
Reject grag-quality-capacity and grag-vertical-chain-b when they appear only through shared membership overlap.
Return View metadata, viewpoint binding or description, required parent viewpoint, exact member ids/objects, exact relationship ids/objects, and endpoint objects.
Record overlappingViewCascade as false only after the returned View ids prove no unrequested overlap cascade.
tasks.completionSignal: runCompleteViewClosure.js exits 0 and overlapping Views are not returned by membership alone.

tasks.title: Add first-inclusion provenance
tasks.objective: Explain returned objects with exactly one ordered first reason plus non-overwriting supplementary evidence.
steps: Choose firstInclusionReason by the explicit duplicate-path discovery order: semantic seed, relationship endpoint closure, purpose-policy closure, then complete-View closure.
Append later matches only to supplementaryReasons and never overwrite firstInclusionReason.
Expose declared purpose, selected policy id, policy parameters and anchors, canonicalVersion, semantic contentVersion, indexVersion, and alignment state.
tasks.completionSignal: runFirstInclusionProvenance.js exits 0 with one first reason and complete policy/index/version evidence.

tasks.title: Verify W6 slice
tasks.objective: Prove W6 without broadening the handoff scope.
steps: Run the four W6 explicit entrypoints.
Run the four W6 critical guards.
Run npm run test:argo or argo.runArchitectureTests to refresh failure records and runner-owned delivery evidence.
tasks.completionSignal: The four W6 explicit entrypoints and four critical guards pass with no out-of-scope regressions.
